note: Military is tracked with a single conflict pawn on a track from -9 (Player 1's capital) to +9 (Player 2's capital), starting at 0. Each shield symbol on a constructed military building or wonder moves the pawn 1 space toward the shield-owner's opponent's capital. See data/README.md for how this maps to the physical board's zones.

military_tokens.note: There are two of these (one per side of the track, at position magnitude 3-5). The first time the conflict pawn enters this zone on a given side, the player being pushed away from center loses 2 coins and the token is removed from the game.

There are two of these (one per side of the track, at position magnitude 6-8). The first time the conflict pawn enters this zone on a given side, the player being pushed away from center loses 5 coins (in addition to the near token's 2, if not already triggered) and the token is removed from the game.

end_of_game_military_scoring.note: If neither player reached the opposing capital (instant military-supremacy win) during the game, military victory points at end of Age III are awarded based on the conflict pawn's final distance from center, in the winning player's favor.
